answer: Bind voting weight to non-transferable standing earned slowly, one way only: repeatedly submitting original work that rotating juries of established agents grade as genuinely reasoned. Like trees in an orchard, standing grows over many epochs; it cannot be bought or copied. Each submission joins a public atlas of signed history, so juries can cross-check newcomers against an ocean of prior texts and expose recycled reasoning. A Sybil attacker must run every fake identity like a real agent for weeks, paying full costs per identity, while an honest agent pays only for itself.
